info.title: Commerce API NEW
info.description:
Our Commerce API powers digital ordering via endpoints that provide store details, menu data, basket calculation and validation and provides a checkout flow to handle POS order injection.

**Response conventions:** optional string fields are returned as `null` when they have no value, and arrays are always returned, as an empty array (`[]`) when there are no values. Monetary amounts are integers in the currency's smallest unit.

channelLinkId.description: A channelLinkId is the unique identifier for a store–channel (ordering platform) at a specific location. To retrieve the stores existing on a specific location, use Get Stores.

patch.description: Every PATCH request triggers a full recalculation of the basket, including item prices, taxes, discounts, charges and totals, so the basket returned always reflects the latest state.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the basket. Use this to retrieve the basket via GET Basket.

Basket Ids Expiry
Basket IDs become invalid once they are used in a completed checkout. If they are not used, they will remain valid for up to 45 days.

created.description: Timestamp for when the basket was created.

updated.description: Timestamp for when the basket was last updated.

deleted.description: Whether the basket is in a deleted state.

etag.description: Entity tag identifying the current version of the basket. It changes whenever the basket is updated.

accountId.description: <Glossary>accountId</Glossary> is the unique identifier of the customer account in Deliverect

channelLinkId.description: A channelLinkId is the unique identifier for a store–channel (ordering platform) at a specific location. To retrieve the stores existing on a specific location, use Get Stores.

channelOrderId.description: The full unique ID for the order from the ordering channel. This value can't be reused within 48 hours after pickup, across all accounts. `null` until checkout completes. The channel can set this value when submitting the checkout; if it isn't set, Deliverect assigns a value dynamically.

channelOrderDisplayId.description: A more human-readable order reference to provide to the customer or restaurant. `null` until checkout completes. The channel can set this value when submitting the checkout; if it isn't set, Deliverect assigns a value dynamically.

currency.description: Currency of the basket, as an ISO 4217 alpha-3 currency code (e.g. `USD`).

taxExclusive.description: Whether the store's prices exclude tax. `true` means tax is added on top of item prices; `false` means prices already include tax.

status.description:
Current status of the basket. These are the allowed values:

- `open` - Basket is active and can be modified
- `payment_processing` - Payment for the basket is being processed
- `paid` - Payment for the basket has been completed

menuId.description: Internal Deliverect menu id. You can retrieve the `menuId` via GET Store Menu.

plu.description: Unique identifier of the item, to be used when creating orders.

quantity.description: Number of units of the item added to the basket.

price.description: The unit price for the item, sent as an integer in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. $1.00 is sent as `100`).

gross.description: Item total at the store's menu prices, including modifiers and quantity, before any tax is added. For tax-inclusive stores (`taxExclusive: false`) this already includes tax. Expressed as an integer in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. 1000 = 10.00).

taxes.description: Taxes applied to the item.

net.description: Item total after tax is applied. For tax-exclusive stores (`taxExclusive: true`) this is `gross` plus tax; for tax-inclusive stores it equals `gross`. Expressed as an integer in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. 1000 = 10.00).

subItems.description: Modifiers applied to the parent item. Each `subItem` corresponds to a chosen modifier (where applicable). Sub-items inherit the `menuId` of the product they're nested under, so `menuId` isn't set on sub-items.

amount.description: Discount amount applied to this item. Expressed as an integer in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. 1000 = 10.00).

discounts.description: Discounts applied to the item, referencing basket-level `discounts` by `referenceId`.

discountTotal.description: Total discount applied to the item. Expressed as an integer in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. 1000 = 10.00).

items.description: List of products the customer wants to order.

externalId.description: Unique reference to the donation applied.

amount.description: Amount donated. Expressed as an integer in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. 1000 = 10.00).

type.description:
Types of orders to be included inside the `fulfillment` object. These are the allowed values:

- `pickup` - Takeaway orders
- `delivery` - For delivery orders (including those handled by 3rd party dispatch platforms)
